newsitem.title: UK: INDEPENDENT INSURANCE UP ON PROFIT, OUTLOOK.
newsitem.headline: INDEPENDENT INSURANCE UP ON PROFIT, OUTLOOK.

text.p: Shares in Independent Insurance Group Plc rose nearly five percent on Wednesday, bucking the market's early markdown, after a jump in first-half profits and an upbeat company statement, dealers said.
By 0758 GMT, Independent Insurance shares gained 42-1/2p to 952-1/2p, near its all-time best 960p hit on Monday, in thin volume of 15,651.
The group reported a 20 percent rise in pre-tax profits to 20 million pounds, excluding realised investment gains of 5.9 million pounds.
The interim dividend was raised 18 percent to 6.25 pence per share.
Chief executive Michael Bright described the performance as "encouraging" despite tough competition in the UK insurance market and he said the group viewed the future with great confidence.
However, he did not foresee a significant upturn in the UK market until late 1998.
